concepts.def: Contracting cloud of gas and dust accreting mass; precursor to a main-sequence star.
Minimum mass of a gas cloud needed for gravitational collapse to overcome thermal pressure.
Balance between inward gravity and outward pressure; stable stars maintain this state.
Hydrogen fusion catalysed by carbon, nitrogen, oxygen; dominant in stars >1.3 solar masses.
Direct proton-proton fusion to helium; dominant in stars below ~1.3 solar masses (incl. Sun).
For main-sequence stars: L is proportional to M to the power ~3.5; massive stars are vastly more luminous.
